# Working notes

These are the project's own working papers, not documentation for anyone installing the plugin. They
are records of a moment — a handoff written on a date, a hosting plan proposed and not executed, a
spike, a compliance sweep, an adversarial UAT run against `v0.3.0` — and they are read as records
rather than corrected into agreement with today's tree. They live under `.github/` rather than in
`docs/` because `docs/` is the consumer's documentation and these are not for a consumer; both are
outside the `lw-watchtower/` payload, so neither reaches an installed machine. For what the plugin
actually does today, read [`docs/`](../../docs/README.md); for what changed and when, read
[`CHANGELOG.md`](../../CHANGELOG.md).
